prompt:

Image 2 is FAST's model sheet: draw FAST exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Dusk under a concrete highway overpass with sodium streetlights. Color split: the left side of the frame is warm and saturated (FAST's side), the right side cool and desaturated (SLOW's side).
Scene: FAST on the left half in hot saturated color, leaping off the car hood toward camera, the crowd behind him jumping with fists raised.
Camera: Low wide, FAST mid-air.
Characters: FAST only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
No readable text, letters, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles anywhere.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
